sentences.text: % 18.12.2023 This application under Section 438 read with Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed on behalf of the Petitioner seeking anticipatory bail in FIR No. 122/2023 dated 08.04.2023 registered under Sections 420/406/120B IPC at P.S. Safdarjung Enclave.

Learned APP, on instructions from the Investigating Officer SI Vikram P.S. Safdarjung Enclave,
submits that in the meantime, a crucial development has taken place that the Petitioner has been declared as a Proclaimed Offender by the learned Trial Court.
Faced with this, learned counsel for the Petitioner, on instructions, seeks to withdraw the present application with liberty to take recourse to appropriate remedies.
Bail Application is disposed of as withdrawn, with liberty as prayed for.
